description: Aménagements cyclables en Corse is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by georchestra.ac-corse.fr. Greenways, bike paths, bike lanes and calm traffic routes of Corsica. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Cycling facilities in Corsica" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include pistes, verte, voies, données ouvertes, cyclables, vélo. The listing shows 2019-08-23 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
